_comment: Optional opt-in hook. Merge into ~/.claude/settings.json hooks.SessionEnd. First handler reminds you to capture durable memories (does NOT auto-extract — heuristic-only and explicitly user-driven). Second handler incrementally reindexes Claude Code session transcripts so memory-search can surface them without a separate cron.

hooks.command: if [ -n "$MEMORY_HOME" ]; then echo '[memory] session ended — if you learned something durable, run `memory-capture` (see the memory skill)'; fi
